nodes.name: AppBootstrap.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level shell component mounted after AppProviders that owns all app-wide hook calls run once per window lifetime — window registration, settings sync, shell appearance, deferred initialization gating, first-paint splash removal — and renders the router alongside the global recovery watchdog and deferred services tree.

nodes.name: AppDeferredServices.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders headless service components (drag-drop, git auto-fetch, process reconciliation, auto-updater, API call inspector, secret capture) that are lazy-loaded and gated until deferred init is ready, and flushes pending terminal persistence writes on beforeunload.

nodes.name: AppGlobalRecovery.tsx
nodes.summary: Watchdog component that detects and repairs stuck drag/resize UI state (leftover resize-active class or cursor style) caused by mouseup events firing outside the window, using debounced and immediate recovery triggers on mousemove, mouseup, blur, and visibilitychange.

nodes.name: E2EBootstrap.tsx
nodes.summary: Dev-only component exposing a window.__e2e API of Tauri-backed test helpers (account, session, workspace, policy, memory, agent-org, MCP, navigation helpers) for WebDriver-driven end-to-end specs; renders nothing and is a no-op until a spec invokes it.

nodes.name: useAppDeferredInitialization.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that runs heavy one-time startup work (cache preload, SessionCore init, tool registry init) after first paint via requestIdleCallback with a setTimeout fallback, returning a ready flag that gates AppDeferredServices.

nodes.name: useAppShellEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that applies global CSS variables and HTML class toggles reflecting user appearance settings (native webview scale, UI font family, fullscreen) stored in Jotai atoms, syncing the native webview zoom via Tauri IPC and cleaning up each effect on unmount.

nodes.name: useFirstPaintSignal.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that fires a first-paint-complete signal after two animation frames confirm the initial render has painted, removes the HTML splash screen, and emits a startup timing metric event for diagnostics.

nodes.name: AppBootstrap
nodes.summary: React FC that wires together all window-lifetime hooks (registration, settings sync, appearance, deferred init, first paint, diagnostics) and renders the router alongside the global recovery watchdog, E2E bootstrap, and deferred services subtrees.

nodes.name: AppDeferredServices
nodes.summary: Renders the set of lazily-loaded headless service components once the ready prop is true, and registers a beforeunload handler that flushes pending terminal persistence writes.

nodes.name: AppGlobalRecovery
nodes.summary: Registers window/document event listeners (mousemove, mouseup, pointerup, blur, visibilitychange) that detect and reset stuck drag/resize UI state, cleaning up listeners and pending timeouts on unmount.

nodes.name: E2EBootstrap
nodes.summary: Builds and attaches the window.__e2e helper namespace (account, session, workspace, policy, memory, runtime debug, agent-org, external-tool, MCP, navigation, benchmark, cloud, user-presence helpers) for WebDriver end-to-end tests, refreshing agent definitions on mount.

nodes.name: useAppDeferredInitialization
nodes.summary: Schedules cache preload, SessionCore initialization, and tool registry initialization during browser idle time (or after a 100ms timeout fallback), returning a boolean once complete while guarding against stale state updates after unmount.

nodes.name: useAppShellEffects
nodes.summary: Applies and cleans up native frame scale CSS variables, UI font family, and fullscreen class in response to Jotai appearance atoms, including a Tauri IPC call to sync webview zoom and a scale-changed listener.

nodes.name: afterRenderableRootContent
nodes.summary: Invokes a callback once the #root element contains renderable content, using a MutationObserver to wait for content when the DOM isn't ready yet at call time.

nodes.name: emitFirstPaintMetric
nodes.summary: Emits an orgii-startup-first-paint Tauri event carrying elapsed startup time, skipped in local dev origins.

nodes.name: useFirstPaintSignal
nodes.summary: Layout effect hook that waits two animation frames after renderable root content appears, then signals first-paint completion, resets chunk reload count, and removes the HTML splash screen element.
